4870706.name: Caleb Downs
4870706.short: Downs recorded 12 total tackles (six solo) during Sunday night's 23-13 loss to the Packers.

4870847.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
4870847.short: Lane brought in four of five targets for 40 yards in the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

4870953.name: Malik Muhammad II
4870953.short: Muhammad (toe) is doubtful to return to Thursday night's contest against the Patriots.

4870988.name: Avieon Terrell
4870988.short: Terrell (back/illness) is inactive against the 49ers on Sunday, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

4870998.name: Josiah Trotter
4870998.short: Trotter recorded 12 total tackles (five solo) and a pass defensed during Sunday's 26-19 overtime loss to the Steelers.

4871023.name: Carnell Tate
4871023.short: Tate caught five of seven targets for 69 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

4873232.name: Mason Graham
4873232.short: Graham (knee/ankle) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Titans, Zac Jackson of The Athletic reports.

4876132.name: Josh Cuevas
4876132.short: Cuevas caught four of five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 13-10 loss to Cleveland.

4879194.name: Josh Cameron
4879194.short: Cameron didn't garner a target and recorded 46 kickoff-return yards during Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans.

4879276.name: Bryce Lance
4879276.short: Lance caught two of four passes for nine yards and a touchdown during the Saints' 34-27 win over the Giants on Sunday.

4880236.name: Will Kacmarek
4880236.short: Kacmarek (hamstring) was limited in Thursday's practice, but he said he expects to play Sunday versus the Jets, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

4880273.name: Kyle Louis
4880273.short: The Dolphins activated Louis (knee) from injured reserve Saturday.

4880281.name: Jordyn Tyson
4880281.short: Saints general manager Mickey Loomis said Tuesday that Tyson (hamstring) is "getting closer" but won't practice this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

4880346.name: Michael Taaffe
4880346.short: Taaffe (chest) did not appear on the Dolphins' injury report Wednesday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

4880613.name: Bam Martin-Scott
4880613.short: The Panthers activated Martin-Scott (hamstring) from injured reserve Saturday, and he no longer carries an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.

4882093.name: Bhayshul Tuten
4882093.short: Tuten carried the ball 12 times for 39 yards and caught all four of his targets for 48 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans.

4887558.name: Emanuel Wilson
4887558.short: Wilson rushed 24 times for 100 yards and a touchdown while catching his lone target for 15 yards in Sunday's 20-3 win over the Chiefs.

4890973.name: Ashton Jeanty
4890973.short: Jeanty rushed eight times for 15 yards and brought in all eight targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

4912052.name: Justin Joly
4912052.short: Joly (concussion) did not appear on the Dolphins' injury report Wednesday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

4912218.name: Cyrus Allen
4912218.short: Allen caught both of his passes for 27 yards during the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

4917635.name: Joshua Williams
4917635.short: The Titans activated Williams (pectoral) from reserve/PUP on Saturday.

4921249.name: Colton Hood
4921249.short: Hood (concussion) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

4954445.name: Dillon Thieneman
4954445.short: Thieneman tallied eight tackles (three solo), including 0.5 sacks, in a 30-24 victory versus the Patriots on Thursday.

5076652.name: Brandon Cisse
5076652.short: Cisse (shoulder) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Lions, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

5081335.name: Drew Stevens
5081335.short: Stevens made his only field-goal try and converted both of his extra-point attempts during Monday's 23-17 loss at San Francisco.

5081397.name: Dylan Sampson
5081397.short: Sampson carried the ball six times for 45 yards and caught all three of his targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Titans.

5081432.name: Antonio Williams
5081432.short: Williams brought in three of four targets for 50 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

5081807.name: Sonny Styles
5081807.short: Styles finished Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers with 13 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense.

5081999.name: CJ Donaldson
5081999.short: Donaldson (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Steelers in Paris.

5082424.name: Dominic Zvada
5082424.short: Zvada missed both of his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 27-21 overtime win against Houston.

5082630.name: Jalen Royals
5082630.short: Royals caught two of his four targets for 24 yards during Kansas City's win over the Chargers on Sunday.

5083076.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
5083076.short: Fannin caught six of nine targets for 91 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Titans.

5083315.name: Kenyon Sadiq
5083315.short: Sadiq caught his lone target for six yards in Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.

5083754.name: Ryan Flournoy
5083754.short: Flournoy caught seven of nine targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Sunday night's 23-13 loss to the Packers.

5085355.name: David Walker
5085355.short: Walker recorded seven total tackles (four solo), including 2.0 sacks, during Sunday's 26-19 overtime loss to Pittsburgh.

5086161.name: Jaden Dugger
5086161.short: Dugger (knee) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Falcons.

5088338.name: Elijah Sarratt
5088338.short: Sarratt (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Bengals.

5088571.name: Bryce Boettcher
5088571.short: Boettcher (groin) is inactive against the Vikings on Sunday.

5092508.name: Colbie Young
5092508.short: Young (knee) was not listed on the Bengals' injury report Wednesday.

5093694.name: Keionte Scott
5093694.short: Scott recorded eight total tackles (four solo), including 1.0 sacks, during Sunday's 26-19 overtime loss to Pittsburgh.

5093923.name: Andrew Armstrong
5093923.short: The Chiefs signed Armstrong from the practice squad to the active roster Friday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

5123663.name: Isaac TeSlaa
5123663.short: TeSlaa failed to haul in either of his two targets during the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

5155825.name: Carter Runyon
5155825.short: The Raiders have ruled out Runyon (foot) for Sunday's game against the Rams.

5209093.name: Michael Jerrell
5209093.short: The Falcons placed Jerrell (biceps) on injured reserve Saturday, Tori McElhaney of the team's official site reports.

5220680.name: Ted Hurst III
5220680.short: Hurst and the other Buccaneers' wide receivers will have elevated roles against the Panthers on Sunday due to the absence of Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot).

5344782.name: Jack Strand
5344782.short: Strand (coach's decision) is inactive as the emergency third quarterback for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

8439.name: Aaron Rodgers
8439.short: Rodgers completed 19 of 30 passes for 212 passes and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints. He added six yards on three carries.
